---
title: Crescentine
id: MAR-0027
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 250 g all-purpose flour
- 40 g butter
- 1 pinch of baking powder
- to taste oil for frying,
- to taste salt,
## Method
1. Pour the flour onto the work surface, add 50 ml of warm water in which you have dissolved the baking powder, a pinch of salt, the butter softened in pieces, and knead, adding the necessary water to obtain an elastic and soft mixture.
2. With a rolling pin, roll out a sheet and fold it over itself four times.
3. Roll out the dough again with the rolling pin and repeat the operation three more times.
4. Now roll out a thin sheet, cut rectangles with the long side of 8 cm and make a small cut in the center.
5. Heat plenty of oil and fry the crescentine, a few at a time.
6. When they have puffed up, drain them with a spatula and place them on paper towels.
7. Serve them hot to accompany cheeses and cured meats.
